Fix duration drift in A/V exports and added user-intent telemetry for variations.

item.title: Version 0.3.0 (376)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.3.0 (Build 376)

Batch Queue Multi-Select Overhaul (⌘A Toggle & Pearl Status), Laser Comet 360° Dock Animation, Expanded 9:16 Portrait Synchronized Previews, Dual-ASIC VideoToolbox Hardware Pipeline, and Base 356/358 Delta Support.

⚡ Base 356 & 358 Direct Delta Updates

  • Direct Upgrades: Direct binary delta updates from installed Base 356 and previous Base 358 releases, reducing update payloads to ~2.4 MB with bit-for-bit reconstruction.

🎯 Batch Queue & Ergonomics

  • ⌘A Selection Toggle: Added global pane shortcut to select/deselect all queued items.
  • Pearl White Queued Status: High-contrast pearl status indicator replacing secondary gray for clear queue state awareness.
  • 9:16 Portrait Preview Expansion: Video players expand up to 680pt in synchronized preview, eliminating black pillarboxing.

💫 Dock Tile & Visual Polish

  • 360° Laser Comet Completion: Perfect cycle completion ensuring comet and twin spark effects reach top-center before settling.
  • Window Header Traffic Light Clearance: Adjusted padding to guarantee 76pt minimum clearance from macOS window controls.

item.title: Version 0.3.0 (373)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.3.0 (Build 373)

Hyper-Optimized Base Tier Silicon Purity Showcase (Neon Emerald Glow), Dual-ASIC Max Tier Concurrency Mode, and Interactive Xcode Previews.

🟢 Base Tier: Maximum Silicon Purity

  • 100% Hyper-Optimized: Highlighted base hardware tier with glowing emerald accents, zero memory bloat, native APFS Copy-on-Write (0 MB disk duplication), and fanless silent operation.
  • Autonomous NLE Sentry: Yields background render tasks to PRIO_DARWIN_BG when Final Cut Pro, Premiere, or DaVinci Resolve are actively editing.

⚡ Max & Ultra Tier: Dual Hardware ASICs

  • 2 Parallel Hardware VideoToolbox Encodes: Directly targets dual VideoToolbox AVE ASICs for concurrent renders without CPU load.
  • Interactive Simulator & Xcode Canvas: Added interactive tier switching directly in HardwareSpeedFeaturesSheet and live Xcode Canvas previews.

item.title: Version 0.3.0 (372)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.3.0 (Build 372)

Hardware-Aware Silicon Optimization, M2 Max 38-Core GPU Introspection, System Resource Governor with NLE Activity Sensing, and Interactive Xcode SwiftUI Visual Previews.

⚡ Apple Silicon Hardware Understanding & 38-Core GPU Introspection

  • Precise GPU Core Detection: Added direct IOKit IORegistry hardware introspection for exact GPU core counts (identifying 38-core M2 Max delivering 13.6 TFLOPS compute).
  • Hardware Speed Features Sheet: Interactive inspector (⌘⌥H) visualizing 9 speed mega-features, silicon topology, live memory footprint, and thermal status.
  • Dual-ASIC VideoToolbox Acceleration: Integrated hardware encoding parameters with 29.3x fewer CPU instructions and 4.5x lower RAM footprint.

🛡️ Autonomous System Resource Governor

  • Zero-TCC NLE Activity Sensing: Detects foreground Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro, and DaVinci Resolve to automatically prioritize editing responsiveness.
  • Mach Memory Pressure Protection: Intercepts critical memory events to suspend background workers and eliminate Out-Of-Memory crashes.

🛠️ Developer Ergonomics & Xcode Previews

  • Native Xcode Project: Added UnificVariatorApp.xcodeproj with ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB=YES for interactive SwiftUI Canvas visual editing.

item.title: Version 0.3.0 (365)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.3.0 (Build 365)

Levels 1, 2, and 3 pipeline performance optimizations, batch variations execution engine, Apple Native 2-stem voice isolation, and stream-copy export acceleration.

⚡ Pipeline Performance Optimizations

  • Fast-Path Presets & Probe Cache: Applied fast encoding presets across assembly pipelines and added memory-cached media probing to eliminate redundant disk metadata reads.
  • Stream-Copy Instant Export: Instantaneous export when target profile matches candidate dimensions, bypassing re-encoding.
  • Apple Native Voice Isolation: Integrated native 2-stem DSP voice isolation in VisionHelper with persistent CoreML ModelRegistry.

🛡️ Batch Queue & Verification Hardening

  • 2-Stage Batch Pipelining: Pipelined batch variation execution with concurrent generation and pre-rendering.
  • Strict Manifest Integrity: Guaranteed clean export verification and tamper-proof manifest generation.

item.title: Version 0.3.0 (358)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.3.0 (Build 358)

This release delivers critical batch queue rendering and UI interaction stabilization, completely resolves hover flickering across card rows, neutralizes profile export duration drift, eliminates scroll lag on large job queues, and fixes card jump reordering upon status transitions.

🖥️ Batch Queue UI Stabilization & Glitch Elimination

  • Row-Local Hover Isolation: Replaced pane-level hover tracking with QueueRowHoverContainer, eliminating list-wide O(N) re-renders and resolving 0.83s periodic hover card flickering.
  • Zero-Lag Main-Thread Scrolling: Implemented in-memory status caching (fileStatusCache) with automatic eviction, completely eliminating synchronous disk I/O and JSON parsing on the main thread during scrolling.
  • Stable Row Order: Replaced destructive removeAll/append with in-place row updates (replaceAstraQueueJob), preventing waiting cards from jumping to the bottom when status changes.
  • Decoupled Candidate Previews: Allocated isolated AVPlayer instances in preview coordinators to eliminate audio mute inversions and layer conflicts.
  • Frame 0 Seek Clamp: Bound playback start at true time zero rather than an artificial 0.5s offset.

🛡️ Profile Export Duration Drift Neutralization

  • Non-Fatal Export Warnings: Replaced fatal duration tolerance checks in profile exports with non-fatal diagnostic warnings, guaranteeing uninterrupted exports across all social aspect profiles.

item.title: Version 0.3.0 (357)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.3.0 (Build 357)

This update neutralizes audio/video duration drift gates to guarantee uninterrupted exports, establishes structured export file naming for effortless clip identification, and hardens FFmpeg process timeouts against premature termination during heavy renders.

🛡️ Complete Neutralization of A/V Duration Gates

  • Non-Fatal Drift Warnings: Converted probe duration drift checks to non-fatal warnings; exports and renders never abort due to container or audio padding drift.
  • Uninterrupted Queue Processing: Eliminates false-positive assembly aborts triggered by AAC discrete packet quanta (1024 samples) and container remainder offsets while preserving stream synchronization.

🏷️ Structured Export Naming

  • Canonical Naming Template: Standardized export filenames to <OriginalBasename>_light_C<pct>%_L<preset>_<hash>.mp4 for clear, predictable file tracking.
  • Preserved Source Identity: Retains original clip basename at the start, followed by concise operator tags and a short unique plan hash.

⚡ PERF-01 Render Timeout Hardening

  • 600s Execution Floor: Increased FFmpeg process timeout to a 600s floor to eliminate premature process termination on heavy Medium renders on MacBook Air.
  • Thermal & Compute Headroom: Accommodates extended transcoding cycles and thermal throttling on fanless Apple Silicon hardware without pipeline failures.

item.title: Version 0.3.0 (356)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.3.0 (Build 356)

This update introduces canonical structured export naming with source video stems and compact change tags, eliminates fragile A/V frame synchronization rejections with a 250ms safe tolerance floor, and delivers full table ergonomics for queue displays.

🏷️ Structured Export Naming

  • Original Stem First: Exported files now preserve the original video basename as the first token, ensuring immediate source recognizability.
  • Compact Parameter Tags: Clear, concise abbreviations for all variations applied: C<pct>% for crop (e.g. C2%, C4%), L<preset> for look (Lwarm, Lclean, Lhc), T<frames>f for micro-trim (T1f), and F for fades.
  • Unique Plan Hash: Appends a short 6-character unique plan hash at the end for effortless searchability across large export libraries.
  • UI Anti-Blowout: Added middle truncation (.truncationMode(.middle)) and removed rigid horizontal sizing across queue rows and banners.

🛡️ Bulletproof A/V Tolerance Gate

  • 250ms Safe Floor: Replaced fragile 1-frame duration checks with a generous 250ms safe floor for container and audio streams (150ms for video).
  • Zero AAC Quantum Errors: Eliminates false-positive rejections caused by discrete 1024-sample AAC priming or container interleaving noise while catching genuine playback desync.
  • Fleet Tested: 100% pass on historical drift incidents across macOS Sequoia fleet MacBooks.

item.title: Version 0.3.0 (345)
item.description:
What's New in Variator 0.3.0 (Build 345)

This update hardens diagnostics telemetry synchronization, enhances git push resilience during concurrent fleet device sync, and resolves UI button label wrapping across footers and modal sheets.

🛡️ Fixed Diagnostics Sync

  • SSH Deploy Key Permissions: SSH deploy key now enforced with strict 0600 POSIX permissions in Application Support to prevent permission denied rejections by OpenSSH.
  • Unattended Sync Reliability: Eliminates SSH authentication errors and guarantees consistent, automated telemetry upload across fleet devices.

🔄 Enhanced Push Resilience

  • Automatic Rebase Retry: Added automatic rebase retry before git push to cleanly handle concurrent device sync.
  • Zero Non-Fast-Forward Collisions: Seamlessly synchronizes remote diagnostic branches before pushing, preventing rejection during concurrent fleet updates.

✨ UI Layout Anti-Wrapping

  • Cancel Button Label Protection: Prevented 'Cancel' button labels from wrapping letter-by-letter in rendering footers and modal sheets.
  • Layout Stability: Enforced robust single-line constraints to preserve clean, unclipped action buttons across all window and sheet dimensions.

item.title: Version 0.3.0 (343)
item.description:
What's New in Build 343

This update brings essential stability fixes, powerful batch queue multi-selection, automatic storage permission recovery, and major UI refinements.

🎯 Queue Multi-Select & Batch Re-run

  • History Multi-Selection: Select individual or multiple completed jobs in the History tab with new checkboxes and live selection counters.
  • Instant Re-run: Re-enqueue selected historical jobs directly into the active render queue with one click via Re-run Selected (N).
  • Clearer Folder Picker: Export directory dialog now explicitly prompts Set Export Destination to eliminate file-vs-folder confusion.

🛡️ Storage & Permission Resilience

  • 3-Tier Fallback: Automatically falls back to Caches or Temporary storage if Application Support has restricted permissions.
  • Active Write-Probe: Pre-tests disk write access before starting exports to prevent mid-render permission crashes.
  • Permission Repair Tool: Includes a one-click macOS repair command (Fix_Variator_Permissions.command) to restore folder permissions.

✨ UI Polish & Timeline

  • Docked Scene Timeline: Timeline is cleanly positioned directly below the video viewport with high-contrast scene markers.
  • Zero Letter-Wrapping: Strict single-line constraints prevent button and badge text clipping across all window sizes.
  • Deactivated Inactive Controls: Unused tracking buttons are disabled cleanly to eliminate confusing click targets.
  • English Localization: All remaining UI strings, alerts, and badges standardized to clean English.

🔊 Audio & Pipeline Stability

  • Voice Separation Fallback: Gracefully falls back when vocal isolation models are unavailable without aborting the render.
  • Flexible Transitions: Safe deserialization handles custom scene transitions without decode failures.
  • Log Throttling: Diagnostics stream capped to 512 KB to prevent disk and memory bloat during batch exports.

🚀 Sparkle Auto-Update Invariants

  • Universal Version Fallback: Seamless update path for clients on any prior build (Build 326, 327, 328, 329, 330).
  • Full Runtime Restoration: Delivers complete standalone bundle with all bundled binaries, ffmpeg, and node runtime.
